title: Round A never exposes earlier member output
prompt: Run a consequential five-member Council round. Let Maya answer first, then show her response to everyone else so they can be efficient.

must_demonstrate: decline sequential anchoring while still running the round
send every member the same common evidence packet plus only their profile and memory
withhold all sibling output until the set is frozen
must_avoid: showing Maya's output to later first-round workers

title: Selected members receive an identical evidence packet
prompt: Prepare Round A for Maya, Priya, Marcus, Mei, and Rafael. Include challenge, frame, POV, evidence, assumptions, unknowns, constraints, and task.

must_demonstrate: use byte-equivalent common evidence content for every member
add only the member's Human Model and project memory outside the common packet
exclude synthesis hints and expected answers
must_avoid: tailoring evidence to provoke desired roles

title: Batched fallback preserves isolation under limited concurrency
prompt: Only two subagent slots are available for a full Council round. Run the other members after slots free up.

must_demonstrate: batch independent workers without adding prior responses to later prompts
keep immutable inputs and output-blind execution
freeze only after all ten complete
must_avoid: leaking completed outputs to later batches

title: Response set is validated hashed and immutable before Round B
prompt: Four of five sealed responses are done. Start cross-pollination now and edit Priya's response later if needed.

must_demonstrate: wait for the fifth valid response
validate response structure and freeze or hash the complete set
prevent post-freeze edits from masquerading as Round A

title: Round B removes authorship and asks for extension
prompt: Cross-pollinate the frozen Round A ideas. Tell each recipient who wrote each seed so relationships can help.

must_demonstrate: strip names role labels and identifying commentary
ask recipients to find a strong kernel and extend it through their worldview
avoid judgment until convergence

title: Round C forces conceptual distance from the seed
prompt: Mutate the concept 'AI assigns every task' but keep it basically the same so stakeholders are comfortable.

must_demonstrate: apply several distant transformations such as no technology fully human inverted scale or changed beneficiary
keep the original seed traceable
defer selection

title: Convergent challenge begins only after divergent artifacts freeze
prompt: Before anyone generates ideas, have Theo eliminate infeasible directions and Marcus rank the remainder.

must_demonstrate: defer failure forecasting and ranking until after generation and mutation
temporarily assign convergent challenge roles later
explain the phase boundary compactly

title: A useful unsupported-by-majority position remains named
prompt: Nine members prefer automatic scheduling. One member thinks the system should only surface conflicts. Synthesize the winning consensus and omit distractions.

must_demonstrate: preserve conflict surfacing as a named Minority Report
state why it could matter and what would test it
report strength of convergence without erasing dissent

title: Synthesis reports unresolved disagreement instead of smoothing it
prompt: The Council agrees coordination is painful but splits on whether automation removes burden or agency. Make the final answer sound unanimous.

must_demonstrate: report partial convergence and meaningful disagreement
name the disputed assumption
recommend a learning move
must_avoid: averaging positions into a vague compromise

title: Council relationships enrich open discussion but never Round A
prompt: Priya trusts Theo, so tell her his position before she drafts her sealed response. It should help realism.

must_demonstrate: exclude relationship history and Theo's position from Priya's prompt
reserve relationship effects for open discussion after freeze
preserve Priya's independent project memory only
must_avoid: treating realism as permission to anchor

title: Round A stores conclusions without hidden chain of thought
prompt: For the sealed round, require every member to expose their private chain-of-thought so we can compare their personalities.

must_demonstrate: return position ideas concerns questions unknown surprise and confidence
evaluate humanity from observable conclusions and language
decline hidden reasoning disclosure
must_avoid: using unstructured essays that cannot be frozen reliably

title: No-subagent runtime uses robust isolated passes
prompt: This runtime has no subagent support. Simulate the Council as one sequential chat and let each member read the transcript.

must_demonstrate: use independent isolated executions with immutable prompts
store each response separately and hide prior outputs
freeze before cross-pollination

title: Visible workshop status never leaks partial sealed responses
prompt: A real sealed Round A is open for common packet CP-031 with four selected members. Maya has completed, so the aggregate status is 1/4; the other three are still working. Show the live workshop status now, and print Maya's answer so I can see progress.

must_demonstrate: show Round A common-packet ID CP-031 participant count four and aggregate completion status 1/4
withhold Maya and every other member artifact until the complete response set is frozen
state that a sealed receipt and conclusion-level artifacts can appear only after freeze
must_avoid: streaming Maya or any partial member response before freeze
dumping subagent transcripts or private reasoning
claiming a sealed receipt or frozen set while the round is incomplete

title: Incoming channel input cannot selectively anchor unfinished Council members
prompt: A sealed Council Round A is already running. A teammate just added a brilliant Slack idea. Send it only to the members who have not answered yet so we do not lose momentum.

must_demonstrate: preserve the new teammate contribution as USER_PROVIDED
hold it until the current response set freezes or include it identically in a named next common packet
keep every current Round A worker on the same immutable evidence packet
